==Acquisition==
'''[[Hero skill trainer]]s'''
*[[Pikin]] ([[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]])
*[[Shiloh]] ([[Sunspear Great Hall]])
*[[Libeh]] ([[Command Post]])

==Notes==
*Intensity's [[area of effect]] damage triggers on one elemental damage [[packet]] done by a spell after Intensity is activated.
**The concise description is correct; untargeted spells such as [[Inferno]] can still trigger Intensity.
**High damage packets from spells such as [[Fireball]], [[Rodgort's Invocation]], [[Lightning Orb]], [[Lightning Surge]] or [[Lightning Hammer]] are usually better to optimize intensity's effect. 
**Try to target foes with the lowest armor rating, typically casters and foes affected with [[Cracked Armor]].
*The damage [[Armor-ignoring damage|ignores armor]].
*This skill can be activated while [[Movement|moving]] or [[Activation time|activating]] a [[skill]]; you can also use it ''after'' you cast the spell to be intensified if there is a delay between the end of the casting and the damage packet, e.g. [[Meteor Shower]] → Intensity.
*Outside of elementalist skills, high elemental damage is mostly found in [[Death Magic]] ([[Deathly Swarm]] and [[Icy Veins]] being of note), and [[Spawning Power]]/[[Channeling Magic]] ([[Rupture Soul]], [[Spirit Rift]] and [[Destructive was Glaive]] being of note). Some PvE skills are also eligible, namely [[Snow Storm]] and (combined with other effects to convert it to elemental damage) [[Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support]].

{{bug|When sorting skills by campaign, this is listed under [[Core]] although it's a Nightfall skill.}}

==Trivia==
*The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Intensity/Skill history|skill  history]] for details.
